scenicChapters.title: Langar → Khargush Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 158 km. 4344 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Khargush Pass → Murghab
